text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour, tested by eng Magdy Saad at 12 March 2005, reviewed by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abd El-Menem El-Emam, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd 
El-Maksoud, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy head sector of talkha PS.
This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Personal 
protective equipment must be used safety shoes, safety helmet, ground strap 
...etc.
Unit must be shut down
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set
Safety 
 helmet and safety shoes, ... etc.
Digital voltmeter Model Fluke 187
Work to be Carried Out
Check o/p of power supply spiced to cards ( + 
 5 , + 15 + 28 ) VDC if o/p voltage not ok, calibrate this voltage by 
 potentiometer within limit ( 2%)
If o/p voltage not ok change power supply .
Check o/p of power supply to relay +28 
 VDC if o/p voltage not ok, calibrate this voltage by potentiometer.
If o/p voltage not ok change power supply.
Turn off power supply special to cards ( + 5 
 , + 15 , + 28 ) VDC within 
 2%
Turn off power supply special to relays ( + 
 28 VDC ).
Remove relays.
Maintain and test relays in laboratory for 
 correct position of contact and coil resistance.
Clean cards base using spray.
Check cables on terminal board.
Return relays to normal position.
Refresh information through jumper for HMPK 
 card.
If problem occur download program from main 
 computer (VAX VMS ) to DMC (DAS, SGC, STC, BOP, MAC).
